title: Apps are not removed from Favorites database when uninstalled which lowers the amount of Favorites that can be saved
line: Favorites in Kickoff and Kicker no longer disappear at login when some favorited apps have been uninstalled.
explanation: Kicker's favorites model loads linked favorites from the activity database with a query limited to 100 results. Entries for apps that are no longer installed are still returned by that query and only dropped afterwards as invalid, so they use up slots and push real favorites past the limit; those favorites vanish after every restart even though they are still saved. The change removes the limit from that query (Limit(0) means no LIMIT clause), so every valid favorite is loaded; stale links are still kept, as cwo asked, so favorites on unmounted or network apps are not lost.

commits.message:
applets/kicker: don't limit the favorites query to 100 entries

Favorites of apps that are no longer installed stay linked and still
counted toward the query's limit of 100 even though they are dropped
afterwards, pushing valid favorites out. Load all linked favorites.

BUG: 506578

patches.diff:
From 49c85628da07aad8bae2db4a2cd0cc20ff77681f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 02:38:19 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/kicker: don't limit the favorites query to 100
 entries

Favorites of apps that are no longer installed stay linked and still
counted toward the query's limit of 100 even though they are dropped
afterwards, pushing valid favorites out. Load all linked favorites.

BUG: 506578
---
 applets/kicker/kastatsfavoritesmodel.cpp | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/applets/kicker/kastatsfavoritesmodel.cpp b/applets/kicker/kastatsfavoritesmodel.cpp
index 224337a54c..9758139565 100644
--- a/applets/kicker/kastatsfavoritesmodel.cpp
+++ b/applets/kicker/kastatsfavoritesmodel.cpp
@@ -173,7 +173,7 @@ public:
 
     Private(KAStatsFavoritesModel *parent, const QString &clientId)
         : q(parent)
-        , m_query(LinkedResources | Agent{AGENT_APPLICATIONS, AGENT_DOCUMENTS} | Type::any() | Activity::current() | Activity::global() | Limit(100))
+        , m_query(LinkedResources | Agent{AGENT_APPLICATIONS, AGENT_DOCUMENTS} | Type::any() | Activity::current() | Activity::global() | Limit(0))
         , m_watcher(m_query)
         , m_clientId(clientId)
     {
--
